title: Average BMI
html:
Average BMI
Skill Type:  Passive
Trainer:  Ranger
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  2227
Increase Health per point of endurance and adds 5 to Agility and Endurance. Decrease Mana per point of Intellect and decreases Strength and Intellect by 5.

Average BMI is a Passive skill that increases Heath gained per point of Endurance but decreases Mana gained per point of Intellect. The skill is useful to characters with low END that need a small health boost. Because the skill also decreases both Intellect and Mana gained per point of Intellect, the skill is geared more towards Fighters and Rangers who don't need a lot of mana and Mages who have so much Intellect and Mana that the losses from the skill are insignificant.


This skill currently only has one level, so it can not be upgraded from skill trainers. Below is the description as it appears in the game.


"Congratulations, you are average! You aren't great, but you don't suck either. You are a bit on the healthier side, gaining additional Health per point of Endurance as well as a few extra points in Endurance. However, all that 'extra' effort has limited your other talents. This decreases your Mana per point of Intellect and your overall Intellect. You haven't let this slow you down though. You make up in your slow wits with your quick feet. You have better Agility at the cost of less Strength.

  • +10% Health per point of Endurance
  • +5 Agility
  • +5 Endurance
  • -5% Mana per point of Intellect
  • -5 Strength
  • -5 Intellect
